post.caption: Man Ray's earrings began as a lampshade. Man Ray was a Surrealist photographer who also designed jewelry. A Milan jeweler made his designs in the 1960s and 1970s. The earrings are titled Pendants Pending, and the spiral came from a lampshade sculpture that hung from a ceiling. They are 18 karat gold, and only twelve pairs were made. Catherine Deneuve wore a pair in a Man Ray photo shoot, and a pair is kept in the Museum of Fine Arts in Boston.
